visualCharacteristics.purpose: Single featured image teaser with an overlapping text panel and link
visualCharacteristics.layout: Square image with a translucent panel over its lower right half (heading, copy, arrow link); panel below the image on mobile
notable: square-text-over-image sets the headline graphic and link text over the image without a panel

contentPattern.structure: One row: picture, heading, copy paragraph(s), a link paragraph (the target); one or two cells

usage: Use to feature one topic or service with a strong image.
reuseGuidance: Fits one teaser; use cards or tiles for several teasers side by side.
